notes.title: About not adapting to the crowd and pirated patches
notes.content:
Not adaptable to the crowd
Although the level-breaking and adventurous game mode has reduced a lot of difficulty, it is still difficult and challenging in comparison. It is not suitable for newcomers (who have not been exposed to RPG) and cultural people who have been eating fast food games for a long time.
Therefore, it is recommended to understand the relevant game content (you can use Baidu Video or join a group to learn more.) After understanding the content, decide whether to buy it.
For cultural people, I suggest reading novels or playing games like Love Live. Get started right away. The game is not easy. Thank you.

About patches.
The patch is more plot gameplay.
Avoid buying pirated copies. A chapter of plot content, etc. will be updated every 1 to 2 months after the original version. Avoid losing money by buying pirated copies.
